invention.ref: Qin Shi Huang's Mausoleum Bronze Chariot No. 1 features a bronze umbrella with mechanical locking joints and tilt adjustments
invention.ref_zh: 秦始皇陵一号铜车马出土大型青铜圆伞，装配有精密齿轮锁扣与多角度转动机构，为已知最早机械结构伞具实物

patent.ref: Samuel Fox patents the lightweight U-shaped grooved steel rib ('Paragon' frame) in Sheffield, UK
patent.ref_zh: 英国设菲尔德的塞缪尔·福克斯取得轻量槽形钢骨伞架专利（Paragon frame），奠定现代雨伞工业构架

mass_production.ref: Jonas Hanway in London popularizes umbrellas for rain protection, prompting commercial workshops to scale production
mass_production.ref_zh: 乔纳斯·汉威在伦敦推动雨伞作为日常防雨工具普及，促使英法工坊开始规模化量产

popularization.ref: Hans Haupt in Germany patents the compact telescopic pocket umbrella (Knirps), popularizing folding rainwear worldwide
popularization.ref_zh: 汉斯·霍普特在德国取得袖珍伸缩折叠伞专利（Knirps），开创全球便携折叠伞普及时代

sources.title: Samuel Fox & the Paragon Umbrella Frame — Great British Life
Knirps Heritage: The History of the Pocket Umbrella — Knirps

summary_zh: 从周代仪仗与秦陵铜车马精密的机械机关伞，到 1852 年英国福克斯发明轻量槽形钢骨，再到 1928 年德国伸缩折叠伞，伞历经数千年演变，成为全球遮阳避雨的随身必备。
summary_en: From Qin chariot bronze umbrellas with mechanical joints to Samuel Fox's 1852 steel frame and 1928 Knirps pocket models, the umbrella evolved into an essential everyday shelter worldwide.
summary_ja: 機械関節のある秦の車の青銅の傘から、1852年の Samuel Fox の鋼骨、1928年のクニルプスの折りたたみまで、傘は日常の雨よけへ発展した。
